title: Aphelion
author: Scott Buckley
credit: 'Aphelion' by Scott Buckley - released under CC-BY 4.0. www.scottbuckley.com.au
character: 安静与沉思的开场，逐步走向合成器和管弦乐高潮。
assessment: 优先试听：适合全片从唤醒、探索到知识汇聚的情绪曲线。

title: Machinery of the Stars
author: Scott Buckley
credit: 'Machinery of the Stars' by Scott Buckley - released under CC-BY 4.0. www.scottbuckley.com.au
character: 向上展开的弦乐与持续推动的电子鼓。
assessment: 偏重 MV 节奏：适合强调几何运动与图形变化的拍点。

title: Signal to Noise
author: Scott Buckley
credit: 'Signal to Noise' by Scott Buckley - released under CC-BY 4.0. www.scottbuckley.com.au
character: 大提琴、钢琴、温暖合成器与低弦乐，神秘而带有希望。
assessment: 偏重沉思氛围：适合当前留白与排版，也需评估全片高潮的力度。
